headline: real-time deepfake/face-swap liveness bypass at video-KYC onboarding, followed by rapid-drain of a profile-inconsistent deposit
typology_name: real-time deepfake/face-swap liveness bypass at video-KYC onboarding
rationale: Yes--implement fix. It is inline with expected risks.
original_rule_text: Documented attack 'real-time deepfake/face-swap liveness bypass at video-KYC onboarding' is not adequately detected because the following indicator(s) do not fire: Credentials or identifiers shared with another account; Crypto-to-plastic conversion or cash-funded credit cards; Rapid pass-through / layering through multiple hops; Source of funds inconsistent with declared wealth; Suspicious-beneficiary VA wallet with little history; AI-orchestrated synthetic-identity impersonation at onboarding. Draft indicator: assess transactions/onboarding exhibiting this pattern, currently outside explicit coverage of the existing rulebook.
